_comment: n8n pod type — installs n8n into a yolks node image so the container's uid (998) matches /home/container ownership. Avoids the EACCES that hits when using the official docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n image (which expects uid 1000).
name: n8n
author: FuelBorn
description: n8n workflow automation. The editor is served at the pod's auto-domain root. Modern n8n uses built-in user management: the first visitor creates the owner account (email + password) in-browser, then everyone logs in against it. Webhooks at /webhook/<path>. Persists to /home/container/.n8n.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail

# Install Node 22 (NodeSource binary tarball; faster than nodesource apt repo and works in the installer image without adding a repo). Then npm install -g n8n. Both go into /mnt/server so they survive into the runtime container at /home/container.
apt-get update >/dev/null
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates xz-utils python3 build-essential >/dev/null 2>&1

NODE_VER=v22.11.0
NODE_ARCH=linux-x64
echo "==> Installing Node $NODE_VER into /mnt/server/.node"
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.node /mnt/server/.n8n /mnt/server/.npm-global
cd /mnt/server/.node
curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/$NODE_VER/node-$NODE_VER-$NODE_ARCH.tar.xz" | tar -xJ --strip-components=1
export PATH=/mnt/server/.node/bin:/mnt/server/.npm-global/bin:$PATH
export HOME=/mnt/server
export npm_config_prefix=/mnt/server/.npm-global
node --version
npm --version

echo '==> Installing n8n via npm (3-5 minutes - first install is heavy)'
npm install -g --no-audit --no-fund n8n 2>&1 | tail -25
echo '==> Verifying'
ls -la /mnt/server/.npm-global/bin/n8n
ls -la /mnt/server/.node/bin/node

# Bake the encryption key on first install so credentials survive restarts.
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/.n8n/config ] && [ -n "${N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY:-}" ]; then
  cat > /mnt/server/.n8n/config <<EOF
{
  "encryptionKey": "${N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY}"
}
EOF
  chmod 600 /mnt/server/.n8n/config
fi

# Drop a startup wrapper so we do not have to keep the full env in the
# egg startup field.
cat > /mnt/server/.n8n-start.sh <<'STARTSH'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
export HOME=/home/container
export N8N_USER_FOLDER=/home/container/.n8n
export PATH=/home/container/.node/bin:/home/container/.npm-global/bin:$PATH
# Internal serving: plain HTTP on :5678, bound to all interfaces. HTTPS is
# terminated by Caddy at the pod's auto-domain. The public URL (used for
# login redirects, the editor's absolute links and webhook URLs) is wired
# in post-deploy via /home/container/.n8n/proxy.env once the subdomain is
# known. Modern n8n uses built-in user management (owner-account setup on
# first visit) - no N8N_BASIC_AUTH_* here.
export N8N_PROTOCOL="${N8N_PROTOCOL:-http}"
export N8N_PORT="${N8N_PORT:-5678}"
export N8N_LISTEN_ADDRESS="${N8N_LISTEN_ADDRESS:-0.0.0.0}"
export N8N_HOST="${N8N_HOST:-localhost}"
export N8N_SECURE_COOKIE="${N8N_SECURE_COOKIE:-true}"
export N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED="${N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED:-false}"
export EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE="${EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE:-true}"
export EXECUTIONS_DATA_MAX_AGE="${EXECUTIONS_DATA_MAX_AGE:-168}"
export N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED=true
mkdir -p "$N8N_USER_FOLDER"
# Public-URL overrides written by the frontend after the auto-domain
# exists (N8N_HOST / N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL / WEBHOOK_URL / N8N_PROXY_HOPS).
[ -f /home/container/.n8n/proxy.env ] && . /home/container/.n8n/proxy.env
cd /home/container
exec /home/container/.node/bin/node /home/container/.npm-global/bin/n8n start
STARTSH
chmod +x /mnt/server/.n8n-start.sh

echo '==> n8n install complete'

variables.name: Public host
variables.description: Public hostname n8n believes it is serving. The frontend sets this to <slug>.bigcat.pw post-deploy.

variables.name: Webhook base URL
variables.description: Public HTTPS URL n8n prints on webhook nodes. Set to the auto-domain post-deploy.

variables.name: Protocol
variables.description: HTTPS terminates at Caddy; n8n itself serves HTTP.

variables.name: Listen port
variables.description: Port n8n binds inside the container. Caddy routes <slug>.bigcat.pw root -> :5678.

variables.name: Encryption key
variables.description: 32-char encryption key for stored credentials. Set at deploy time; do not change.

variables.name: Execution data retention (hours)
variables.description: How long to keep execution traces. Defaults to 7 days.

variables.name: Editor base URL
variables.description: Public URL where users reach the editor + login. Set to the auto-domain post-deploy.

variables.name: Reverse-proxy hops
variables.description: Number of reverse proxies in front of n8n (Caddy = 1). Lets n8n trust X-Forwarded-* for correct cookies/redirects.

variables.name: Listen address
variables.description: IP n8n binds inside the container.

variables.name: Secure cookie
variables.description: Send the auth cookie only over HTTPS. Safe because access is via Caddy TLS.
